title.zh: 将哥打巴托副区工程办公室升格为正式区工程办公室，名称为哥打巴托市区工程办公室，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Upgrading the Cotabato Subdistrict Engineering Office into a Regular District Engineering Office to be Known as the Cotabato City District Engineering Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Upgrading the Cotabato Subdistrict Engineering Office into a Regular District Engineering Office to be Known as the Cotabato City District Engineering Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Cotabato Subdistrict Engineering Office is hereby upgraded into a regular district engineering office to be known as the Cotabato City District Engineering Office.
The said district engineering office shall comprise all the barangays in Cotabato City and shall assume jurisdiction over all infrastructure and public works in Cotabato City.

The Secretary of Public Works and Highways shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Cotabato City District Engineering Office, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Cotabato Subdistrict Engineering Office. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the said district engineering office shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
